shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A woman in an emerald blouse asks a question at the pinboard-side window seat, while a man in a navy blazer sits at the entrance-side window seat and a woman in a mustard cardigan sits at the pinboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in a navy blazer leaves the entrance-side window seat and exits the venue, while the woman in an emerald blouse speaks.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in an emerald blouse answers.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the worktable, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.
